"""Live RoboCasa365 controller for the one-shot SanitizePrepCuttingBoard episode.
Only RGB/depth observations, camera calibration and the robot proprioception are used.
"""
import json, pathlib, time
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = pathlib.Path('/app/output')
CAMERAS = ['robot0_agentview_center','robot0_agentview_left','robot0_agentview_right','robot0_eye_in_hand']
class Controller:
    def __init__(self):
        self.r = Robot()
        self.spec = self.r.spec()
        self.q = np.asarray(self.r.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video='none').meta['proprio']['now'][4:11], dtype=float)
        self.grip = -1.0
        print('connected', self.spec['control_dt'], self.r.status())
    def action(self, q=None, grip=None, base=(0,0,0), torso=0, mode=-1):
        q = self.q.copy() if q is None else np.asarray(q, dtype=float)
        grip = self.grip if grip is None else float(grip)
        return np.r_[q, grip, np.asarray(base,dtype=float), float(torso), float(mode)]
    def move(self, q, seconds=2.0, grip=None, cameras=None, note='arm waypoint'):
        q0 = self.q.copy(); q1 = np.asarray(q,dtype=float)
        n=max(1,int(round(seconds/self.spec['control_dt'])))
        arr=np.tile(self.action(q=q0,grip=grip),(n,1))
        for i in range(n): arr[i,:7]=q0+(q1-q0)*(i+1)/n
        res=self.r.submit('joint_position',arr,cameras=cameras or CAMERAS,video='none',note=note)
        self.q=q1.copy()
        if grip is not None: self.grip=float(grip)
        print('move',note,'steps',res.meta.get('control_steps_chunk'),'eef',res.meta.get('proprio',{}).get('now',[None]*29)[26:29], 'left',res.meta.get('time_left_s'))
        return res
    def hold(self, seconds, cameras=None, depth=True):
        res=self.r.get_obs(cameras=cameras or CAMERAS,seconds=seconds,include_depth=depth,video='none')
        return res
    def observe(self, cameras=None, depth=True):
        return self.r.get_obs(cameras=cameras or CAMERAS,include_depth=depth,video='none')
    def save(self,res,name):
        d=OUT/name; d.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        res.save(str(d))
        return d
    def base(self, vector, seconds, q=None, grip=None, mode=1, note='base move'):
        n=max(1,int(round(seconds/self.spec['control_dt'])))
        arr=np.tile(self.action(q=q,grip=grip,base=vector,mode=mode),(n,1))
        res=self.r.submit('joint_position',arr,cameras=CAMERAS,video='none',note=note)
        # q is servo target, retained if supplied
        if q is not None: self.q=np.asarray(q,dtype=float).copy()
        if grip is not None: self.grip=float(grip)
        print('base',note,'steps',res.meta.get('control_steps_chunk'),'left',res.meta.get('time_left_s'))
        return res

if __name__=='__main__':
    c=Controller()
    print(json.dumps(c.spec,indent=2))
